instruction: Create a clustered bar chart (horizontal bars) showing the Sales and COGS data for each week in a new sheet. Set the chart title as "Weekly Performance".

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a horizontal bar chart (not column chart) with title 'Weekly Performance' in a new sheet. The evaluator verifies: 1) Chart type is BarChartType (horizontal bars), 2) Title is correct, 3) Chart is in a new sheet (not Sheet1).

llm_judge_reasons: Critical coverage gap: Instruction requires 'Sales and COGS data for each week' but evaluator does NOT verify the chart contains these specific data series
The evaluator only checks chart type (BarChartType), title ('Weekly Performance'), and sheet location (new sheet)
Missing verification: No check for Sales data series presence
Missing verification: No check for COGS data series presence
Missing verification: No check that chart is 'clustered' (multiple series) vs stacked or other bar chart variants
A chart with wrong data (e.g., only Revenue, or only one series) would incorrectly pass with full score
The 3 checks that exist are logically correct and will work at runtime
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add verification that chart contains a data series with 'Sales' in the name/label
Add verification that chart contains a data series with 'COGS' in the name/label
Verify chart has at least 2 series (for 'clustered' requirement)
Consider checking chart.grouping attribute to confirm it's 'clustered' not 'stacked'
Update scoring weights to include data series verification (e.g., 0.3 for chart type, 0.3 for title, 0.2 for new sheet, 0.2 for data series)
